title: SIDESTORY: GRANI AND KNIGHTS' TREASURE - RERUN OPEN
lines: 01 RERUN SIDE STORY GRANI AND THE KNIGHTS' TREASURE

DETAILS: Grani and the Knights' Treasure event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Bounty Coins, Express Chain Pizzeria (pieces), Elite Materials, etc.
*Players who clear the event stage GT-3 for the first time can obtain the event Operator ★★★★★: Grani
MAIN REWARDS: Grani's Token, Express Chain Pizzeria (pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
During this rerun event, the stage progress from its first release will be kept and the first-clear reward will not be reset.
During this rerun event, some rewards that cannot be obtained repeatedly will be converted into Intelligence Certificate in the corresponding conversion.
Please check the Intelligence Certificate Converting Rules in the event for more details.
Converted Intelligence Certificate can be used to exchange in Certificate Store.
Skadi, Grani, Nightmare and Beehunter will gain more trust within this event
02 GRANI AND THE KNIGHTS' TREASURE RERUN SIGN-IN
DETAILS: During the event, Players can obtain Bounty Coins through a 9-day Sign-in event, Bounty Coins can be used to redeem rewards from Clearing House
03 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN - BEHOLD THE SWORD OF TIDE
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Behold the Sword of Tide", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
Event Operator Grani can only be obtained as event reward and will not appear in "Behold the Sword of Tide" or other Standard Headhunting

06 NEW ARRIVALS AND RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection – Miraculous Moment for Grani
Pioneer Series – Iron Block for Jessica
07 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET EXPRESS CHAIN PIZZERIA
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event
Grani and the Knights' Treasure event rewards and redeem in Clearing House (Pieces)
